Maharashtra Milk Prices to Increase by Rs 2 Per Litre

Milk prices in Maharashtra will increase by Rs 2 per litre starting August 11. The hike applies to both cow and buffalo milk. The decision was made by the Milk Producers and Processors Welfare Association, citing rising costs of diesel, packaging, and milk procurement. Dairy products like curd and paneer may also see a price increase of up to 10%.
